deadline.value: January 15, 2027 for full consideration (fall only); later files reviewed up to April 15 but may miss scholarship/TA support
deadline.quote: The application deadline for full consideration for fall 2027 admission is January 15, 2027. | Applications received after the deadline for fall admission may be reviewed and considered up to April 15th.

app_fee.value: USD 120 for international students on a nonimmigrant visa studying in the U.S. (USD 75 for U.S. citizens/PRs and for international online students outside the U.S.)
app_fee.quote: $120: International students on any nonimmigrant visa type studying in the U.S. (e.g., F-1, H1-B, H-4, etc).

fee_waiver.value: Department hardship waivers from a limited budget, first come until funds run out and no later than December 4, 2026; request after filling the application up to the payment page (150-word essay, statement, transcripts, English proof if non-native). No citizenship restriction stated.
fee_waiver.quote: Application Fee Waiver - Open till December 4, 2026 | Applicants facing financial hardship may request a waiver for their application fee. | The Department of Physics has established a limited budget for these waivers. Fee Waiver requests will be considered as they are received until funds are depleted, but no later than December 4.

gre_general.value: Not required; may be supplied as supplemental documentation
gre_general.quote: The Department of Physics no longer requires verbal, quantitative or analytical GRE scores. | However, if you wish to supply these scores, you may supply them as part of your supplemental documentation.

gre_physics.value: Not required; may be supplied as supplemental documentation
gre_physics.quote: We also do not require the Physics GRE. However, if you wish to supply these scores, you may supply them as part of your supplemental documentation.

toefl_min.value: University minimum TOEFL 80 (before Jan 21, 2026) or 4 (new scale); IELTS 6.5; PTE 60. CONFLICT: the department page cites an older 83 iBT minimum and says it looks for scores about 15% above the minimum because of TA duties; it lists TOEFL, IELTS or PTE only (Duolingo not mentioned)
toefl_min.quote: For exams taken before January 21, 2026: Minimum score of 80. | For exams taken on or after January 21, 2026: Minimum score of 4.

also.quote: ASU requires international students to have minimum TOEFL scores of 515 (PBT), 213 (CBT), or 83 (iBT). At the department level, we look for scores about 15% above these minima, since language skills are critical for teaching assistant positions.

english_waiver.value: India is not on ASU's English-speaking country list, but a bachelor's or higher from an institution where English was the ONLY language of instruction can be exempted via the Medium of Instruction form with an official letter (or institution website link). The department page says internationals must show proficiency via TOEFL, IELTS or PTE, so confirm with the department.
english_waiver.quote: Degree from an International Institution Where English is the Sole Medium of Instruction | Earned a bachelor’s degree or higher from an international institution where English was the only language of instruction. | A letter on official letterhead from the institution confirming English as the sole language of instruction OR a link to the institution’s official website verifying the language of instruction

also.quote: Gambia, The Grenada Guam Guyana Ireland Jamaica Kenya
International applicants must demonstrate English proficiency via the TOEFL, IELTS or PTE.

supervisor.value: Applicants are encouraged to contact faculty and list prospective advisors; this helps judge fit and future RA support
supervisor.quote: Yes, applicants are encouraged to communicate with faculty they are interested in working with and to list the names of prospective faculty advisors on their application.

funding.value: Not stated on the pages checked (late applicants may miss scholarships, fellowships or TA support)

entry_route.value: A bachelor's or master's in physics or a closely related area qualifies; without a master's, 30 elective credits make up the 84 required
entry_route.quote: Have earned a bachelor's or master's degree in physics or a closely related area, from a regionally accredited institution.

also.quote: If students do not have a previously awarded master's degree, the 30 credit hours of coursework are made up of electives to reach the required 84 credit hours.

notes: Minimum GPA 3.00 in the last 60 hours of the first bachelor's (or in a master's). First-year PhD students do PHY 500 research rotations. ASU does not accept the at-home GRE General Test.
